e.title: CEPAR（新南威尔士大学人口老龄化研究卓越中心）：研究计划与老龄化数据档案
e.title_en: CEPAR (ARC Centre of Excellence in Population Ageing Research, UNSW): research programmes and a population-ageing data archive
e.title_hk: CEPAR（新南威爾士大學人口老齡化研究卓越中心）：研究計劃與老齡化數據檔案
e.summary: 澳洲人口老龄化研究中心：分阶段研究计划（2025 起）、出版物库与「人口老龄化未来数据档案」（含老龄化预测），另有年报
e.summary_en: Australia’s population-ageing research centre: phased research programmes (2025 onward), a publication library and a "Data Archive for Population Ageing Futures" with ageing projections, plus annual reports
e.summary_hk: 澳洲人口老齡化研究中心：分階段研究計劃（2025 起）、出版物庫與「人口老齡化未來數據檔案」（含老齡化預測），另有年報
e.body:
**CEPAR（ARC Centre of Excellence in Population Ageing Research，人口老龄化研究卓越中心）** 设于**新南威尔士大学（UNSW）**，是**澳大利亚政府「卓越研究中心」计划资助的老龄化研究机构**。本条属本轮**新形态**：实测池内**「研究机构与研究网络」这一整类此前为 0**（池内有**期刊**（[[annals-of-actuarial-science]]、[[european-actuarial-journal]]、[[geneva-papers]]、[[astin-bulletin]]）、**专业团体**、**监管机构**与**数据源**，但**「做研究并产出可引用成果的机构/网络」缺位**；实测 **CEPAR 相关条目为 0**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 51.7KB；**研究栏目 `/research`（36.3KB）**，实测按阶段列出研究计划——**Research Program（2025 - present）**、**（2017 - 2024）**、**（2011 - 2017）**；**出版物页 `/publications`（553.3KB，体量显示条目众多）**；⭐ **「CEPAR Data Archive for Population Ageing Futures（人口老龄化未来数据档案）」页 `/cepar-population-ageing-projections`（51.4KB）**；另有 **Annual Reports（年报）** 页。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「老龄化研究机构 + 数据档案」这一形态**——池内人口/死亡率侧已有官方数据（[[un-population-data]] 的联合国人口预测、[[who-gho]]、[[eurostat]]、[[ihme-gbd]]）与建模工具（[[mortalitylaws]]、[[demotools]]、[[granmomo-rs]]），但**「由研究机构维护、面向老龄化未来的专门数据档案与预测」此前没有**；对做**老龄化、长寿风险与养老金可持续性**方向论文的学生，这是**既有一手投影又可引用的研究型来源**。**② 与养老金制度样本互补**——本会话已收七个养老金机构样本（[[pbgc]]、[[gad-uk]]、[[dnb]]、[[pensions-authority-ie]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]]、[[cmf-chile]]、[[pensionsmyndigheten]]），**CEPAR 补的是「学术侧如何看待同一问题」**，可与 [[retirement-planning]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]、[[ap7]] 并读。**③ 研究计划的分阶段存档**本身是**学术脉络的现成素材**（2011→2025 三期，看得出研究议程如何演变）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页、研究页、出版物页、数据档案页与年报页的存在及页面体量**，**但未打开任何出版物或下载任何数据**，因此**不能确认数据档案的具体字段、许可与开放程度**；**②** 出版物页体积很大（553KB），**说明列表条目多，但本次未统计条目数**；**③** 站点为**研究机构官网**，**不提供精算软件**；**④** 数据档案的**更新频率与访问条件未核实**。**核实说明**：首页（51.7KB）、`/research`（36.3KB）、`/publications`（553.3KB）、`/cepar-population-ageing-projections`（51.4KB）均 HTTP 200 实测；**未打开出版物、未下载数据**。
e.body_en:
**CEPAR (the ARC Centre of Excellence in Population Ageing Research)** is hosted at **UNSW** and funded under **Australia’s ARC Centres of Excellence scheme**. This entry introduces a new form this round: a measured search found **the whole category of "research institutions and research networks" absent** (the corpus had **journals** ([[annals-of-actuarial-science]], [[european-actuarial-journal]], [[geneva-papers]], [[astin-bulletin]]), **professional bodies**, **regulators** and **data sources**, but nothing for **institutions and networks that produce citable research**); **CEPAR-related entries measured zero**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is 51.7KB; the **research section `/research` (36.3KB)** lists research programmes by phase — **Research Program (2025 - present)**, **(2017 - 2024)** and **(2011 - 2017)**; the **publications page `/publications` (553.3KB**, its size indicating a large catalogue); ⭐ the **"CEPAR Data Archive for Population Ageing Futures" page `/cepar-population-ageing-projections` (51.4KB)**; plus an **Annual Reports** page.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "ageing research centre with a data archive" form** — the population and mortality side of the corpus already has official data ([[un-population-data]] UN projections, [[who-gho]], [[eurostat]], [[ihme-gbd]]) and modelling tools ([[mortalitylaws]], [[demotools]], [[granmomo-rs]]), but **a research-maintained archive and projections aimed specifically at ageing futures had no entry**; for students writing on **ageing, longevity risk and pension sustainability**, this is a **research-grade source that supplies both primary projections and citable studies**. **② It complements the pension institutional samples** — this session has already collected seven ([[pbgc]], [[gad-uk]], [[dnb]], [[pensions-authority-ie]], [[apra-superannuation-statistics]], [[cmf-chile]], [[pensionsmyndigheten]]), and **CEPAR adds the academic view of the same questions**, readable with [[retirement-planning]], [[longevity-mortality-investor]] and [[ap7]]. **③ The phased research-programme archive** is itself **ready material on how a research agenda evolved** (three phases from 2011 to 2025).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the existence and page sizes of the homepage, research page, publications page, data archive page and annual reports page**, **but opened no publication and downloaded no data**, so **the archive’s fields, licensing and openness cannot be confirmed**; **②** the publications page is large (553KB), **indicating many entries, but the number was not counted**; **③** this is a **research institution’s website and offers no actuarial software**; **④** the archive’s **update frequency and access conditions were not verified**. **Verification note**: the homepage (51.7KB), `/research` (36.3KB), `/publications` (553.3KB) and `/cepar-population-ageing-projections` (51.4KB) were all measured at HTTP 200; **no publication was opened and no data was downloaded**.
e.body_hk:
**CEPAR（ARC Centre of Excellence in Population Ageing Research，人口老齡化研究卓越中心）** 設於**新南威爾士大學（UNSW）**，由**澳洲政府卓越研究中心計劃**資助。本條屬本輪**新形態**：實測池內**「研究機構與研究網絡」這一整類此前為 0**；**CEPAR 相關條目為 0**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 51.7KB；**研究欄目（36.3KB）**按階段列出研究計劃（**2025 起**、2017–2024、2011–2017）；**出版物頁 553.3KB**；⭐ **「人口老齡化未來數據檔案」頁 51.4KB**；另有**年報**頁。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「老齡化研究機構 + 數據檔案」這一形態**——池內已有官方人口數據（[[un-population-data]]、[[who-gho]]、[[eurostat]]、[[ihme-gbd]]）與建模工具，但**「由研究機構維護、面向老齡化未來的專門數據檔案與預測」此前沒有**；**② 與七個養老金機構樣本互補**（[[pbgc]]、[[gad-uk]]、[[dnb]]、[[pensions-authority-ie]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]]、[[cmf-chile]]、[[pensionsmyndigheten]]），**CEPAR 補的是「學術側如何看待同一問題」**；**③ 研究計劃的分階段存檔**本身是**學術脈絡的現成素材**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**五個頁面的存在與體量**，**但未打開任何出版物或下載任何數據**；**②** 出版物頁體量大但**未統計條目數**；**③** 本站為**研究機構官網，不提供精算軟件**；**④** 數據檔案的**更新頻率與訪問條件未核實**。**核實說明**：四頁 HTTP 200 實測；**未打開出版物、未下載數據**。
